messages.subject: Re: Non-significant factor loading
parts: Sure, you can use that measurement model for a user GWAS. You may consider dropping the nonsignificant loadings. Alternatively, you may choose to leave them in, perhaps because their standardized values are nontrivial, albeit nonsignificant.  Your modeling decisions, and how you interpret your results, will depend on your knowledge of the data (e.g. what the variables are, how well powered the individual GWASs are...etc...).
